releases.notes:
## Item Flow Monitor v1.0.0

Real-time item flow rate overlay for Minecraft containers.

### Highlights

- Real-time items/sec, items/min, items/hour rate overlay
- Time-to-full estimate tooltip on hover
- Three calculation modes: Average, Actual, Predicted (EMA)
- All standard containers: chests, double chests, hoppers, furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers, barrels, dispensers, droppers, shulker boxes
- Three tracking modes: All Items, First Item (auto), Pick Item (manual)
- Settings panel with toggle, period, rate mode, tracking mode, item selector, reset
- Config screen via Mod Menu (toggle per container type)
- Lithium compatible
- 12 languages

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API 0.141.2+

### Install

Drop `itemflowmonitor-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder.

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/fylhtq7779/ItemFlowMonitor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
Also available on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-flow-monitor).
